text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali meets Palestinian President Arafat, who briefs him on negotiations with Israel.
- Ulysse, new ship of Compagnie Tunisienne de Navigation, will start service by end of June.
- Sudanese President Bashir sends message to President Ben Ali about situation in eastern Sudan.
- Mohamed Soudani named governor of Sousse province.
- 300 travel agents from Switzerland visit Tunisian resort of Hammamet this week.
- National Solidarity Fund starts distributing presidential aid to 25,000 poor families on occasion of Eid al-Fitr Moslem holiday.
